text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp said Tuesday it expects earnings per share of about $0.08 on revenues of about $250 million for its third fiscal quarter ended March 31.
The company said analysts expects it to have earnings of $0.15 a share on revenues of about $260 million.
First Call's consensus among seven analysts is $0.14 a share.
For the year-ago third quarter, the company reported revenues of $225 million and a loss of $0.02 per share, excluding restructuring and special charges.
Sensormatic blamed the performance of its retail business in the United Kingdom for the lower-than-expected earnings for the quarter.

"The UK retail operation has been affected by management changes and a repositioning of its marketing efforts," it said. "Recently, Sensormatic appointed new managing and finance directors for this operation."
It said it successfully completed a $160-million asset securitization program in the UK in March to provide liquidity for its vendor-financed activities.
"This securitization program will have a positive impact on Sensormatic's cash flow and lower its investment in receivables," it said.
The company, which plans to release the results in the second or third week of May, said its three other divisions were performing as expected.
